calls.summary: Bind an HTTP/1.1 listener and return its handle.
Accept one bounded HTTP/1.1 request and return its carrier.
Write one HTTP response for a pending request.
Begin a chunked HTTP response and return its writer handle.
Write one chunked frame; blocks under backpressure.
Finish a chunked response and apply keep-alive policy.
Stop an HTTP listener and close its connections.
Create an HTTP client agent handle for connection reuse.
Send one HTTP GET and return the buffered response.
Send one HTTP POST and return the buffered response.
Send one HTTP PUT and return the buffered response.
Send one HTTP DELETE and return the buffered response.
Send one HTTP PATCH and return the buffered response.
Send one HTTP request with an explicit method and return the buffered response.
Send one HTTP request and return a reader handle for incremental receive.
Read one bounded body chunk from an open request; never drains the remainder. Cancellation is entry-only: a blocked read is not interruptible mid-syscall.
